discovered.name: App Stability and Order Execution
discovered.description: Users complain about app lag, freezing during active market hours, and delayed or malfunctioning stop-loss and order executions causing financial losses.

discovered.description: Users report unresponsive customer care, endless hold times on calls, unhelpful automated messages, and tickets left unresolved for days.
